answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 26305 Country: India Title: What is the meaning of ADI AND RAYYAN IS THIS BETTER OR NOT? Question: what is the meaning of ADI AND RAYYAN IS THIS BETTER OR NOT? Answer ID: 26305 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2486/1552/H=1431) Adi is the name of a famous tribe. There is no harm in keeping this name. Rayyan means: great scholar, beautiful, one who has strong waist, one who knows the art of riding. Rayyan is good name and carries excellent meaning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
